queries:
SELECT u.id,u.username,u.full_name,sm.server_role,COALESCE(activity.messages,0) messages,activity.last_message
                FROM server_members sm JOIN users u ON u.id=sm.user_id
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.sender_id,COUNT(CASE WHEN m.created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) messages,MAX(m.created_at) last_message
                    FROM messages m JOIN channels c ON c.id=m.channel_id
                    WHERE c.server_id=? AND m.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY m.sender_id) activity ON activity.sender_id=u.id
                WHERE sm.server_id=? AND u.id<>? AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY messages DESC,u.username LIMIT 500

SELECT u.id,u.username,u.full_name,sm.server_role,COALESCE(activity.messages,0) messages,activity.last_message
                FROM server_members sm JOIN users u ON u.id=sm.user_id
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.sender_id,COUNT(CASE WHEN m.created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) messages,MAX(m.created_at) last_message
                    FROM channels c STRAIGHT_JOIN messages m ON m.channel_id=c.id
                    WHERE c.server_id=? AND m.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY m.sender_id) activity ON activity.sender_id=u.id
                WHERE sm.server_id=? AND u.id<>? AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY messages DESC,u.username LIMIT 500
